title: Feature inspection protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Feature inspection should complete this objective: Use permutation importance and partial dependence. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Investigate model behavior.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Explain correlated-feature caveats and why importance is not causation.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for permutation_importance, PartialDependenceDisplay and does not run the learner code. Explain correlated-feature caveats and why importance is not causation.
